# semvers Provider

Implements `semvers_list` data source, `compare`, `constrained`, `equals`, `sort` and `pick` provider function. All functionality is based on `github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3`. Usage of provider functions requires Terraform version 1.8 and above. Version strings are parsed leniently: a leading `v` and missing minor or patch parts are accepted, so `v1.2` is read as `1.2.0`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    semvers = {
      source = "anapsix/semvers"
    }
  }
}

provider "semvers" {}

data "semvers_list" "example" {
  list = [
    "0.1",
    "v0.1.1+hotfix",
    "v0.2.0",
    "v0.10.0",
    "v5.0.1-rc1+43fbedb",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ignore_invalid_tags` (Boolean) When true, invalid semver strings in list inputs are skipped instead of returning an error. Applies to the `semvers_list` data source only; provider functions cannot read provider configuration, so pass `ignore_invalid` to `sort` / `pick` instead. Skipped tags are logged at INFO level when `TF_LOG` is enabled. If the value is not known until apply (e.g. derived from a resource attribute), `semvers_list` returns an error when the list contains invalid strings. Defaults to `false`.
